about.skills.tech.title: Technical Skills
about.skills.tech.content:
OPERATING SYSTEMS: Windows 10/11, Ubuntu, Kali, Linux Mint (basic), macOS
WORKSTATIONS: Assembly, optimization, restoration, maintenance, and troubleshooting
NETWORKING: LAN, DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, file sharing, Wi-Fi configuration, network troubleshooting and security, Packet Tracer network design
CYBERSECURITY: Fundamentals, best practices, traffic analysis with Wireshark, and threat awareness
SERVERS & VIRTUALIZATION: Windows Server, Ubuntu Server, VirtualBox, Hyper-V, Proxmox (basic)
SCRIPTING & AUTOMATION: PowerShell (basic), Bash (basic)
PERIPHERALS: Installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of printers, scanners, IP cameras, and mobile devices
TOOLS: Hiren's Boot, WinPE, Paragon, Active Directory, basic ticketing systems, and Wireshark
about.skills.dev.title: Development Skills
about.skills.dev.content:
LANGUAGES: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C
FRAMEWORKS: Django, React, React Native
DATABASES: SQL (data modeling, queries, and administration)
TOOLS: Git, GitHub, Visual Studio Code, PyCharm, Docker
OTHER: RESTful API design, web and mobile app development, and cloud deployment
